frames.frame: with + [NP] + [补语]，[主句]（with-复合结构伴随状语）
frames.gloss: 在……（某状态/情形）之下，与此同时主句发生——with 引出一个自带小主谓的伴随结构。
frames.pattern_notes:
with 后接「名词 + 补语」的小主谓结构，补语可为形容词（fresh in his mind）、过去分词（generated in California）或介词短语（for almost everything）；with 整体作状语，不是「用……」的工具状语，也不追问分词的施事。
误读点：学习者易把 NP + V-ed 切成「介词宾语 + 后置定语」，或把 with 短语读成修饰邻近名词的定语；整存整取才能读出 NP 与补语之间的主谓（或被动）关系。
此前 result_009（S06884，V-ed）与 result_011（V-ing）各记 1 例候选，本批 3 例干净语料（形容词/过去分词/介词短语三种补语），达两句门槛，正式收录。另有弱形式「with + NP1 + of NP2」表属性（S01941 with clay floors and roofs of grass），无谓词性补语，不单独计。

examples.s: With Alaska fresh in his mind, he tried to sell the story of his journey up north to several publishers and magazines, but no one seemed interested.
The USA has the largest capacity, with over 80% generated in California.
There are various kinds of theme parks, with different parks for almost everything: food, culture, science, cartoons, movies, history, and so on.

frames.frame: The [评价性NP] is [to V / V-ing]（first step / main thing…）
frames.gloss: （做某事的）第一步/关键在于……——名词化主语 + 系动词 + 不定式或动名词表语的定义性句式。
frames.pattern_notes:
已收「The aim/purpose of X is to」的同族新变体：aim/purpose 槽位可换成 the first step、the main thing 等评价性名词，且表语既可 to-V（J04034）也可 V-ing（S01065/S06772），两者可互换；result_005 候选「The best way to V is to」亦属本族。
误读点：学习者在 be 后期待名词短语，或把 to-V/V-ing 误读成目的状语，实为表语；该句式是说明文、操作指南、建议段的高频定义性开头，整存整取可一次掌握槽位与表语形式。

examples.s: " He thinks the first step is to find someone you trust to talk to.
The first and most important step in the treatment of burns is giving first aid.
The main thing is reminding distracted students that they need to pay attention in class.

frames.gloss: A 说 B／用 B 这个说法是什么意思？——对措辞、引文、标题的追问句式。
frames.pattern_notes:
mean 与 by 固定搭配：by 引出被追问的言语、引文或 V-ing 说法，全句询问「意图何在」，不是问词义本身；勿把 by 读成「被」或「通过」。
同样结构常见于日常追问（What do you mean by that?）；两例为教材理解题但主语与被问内容各异，非模板同构。

examples.s: What does the writer mean by “Slowly, the city began to breathe again”?
What does Nora mean by saying that she needs time to polish her writing?

frames.frame: not/no longer as [A] as [before / it once was]
frames.gloss: 不像从前那样……——同级比较的否定式，且比较基准是过去状态。
frames.pattern_notes:
已收 as...as 为基础式，此为「今昔对比」变体：比较基准槽位填 before 或 it once was（主语与主句相同、谓语回到过去时），比较的是现在的 A 与过去的 A；no longer 可与 not as...as 叠加（S07553）。
误读点：as it once was 里的过去时 was 与回指主语易被逐词读漏，导致今昔对比丢失；「not as successful as before」也易被读成单纯的比较而非「今不如昔」的评价。

examples.s: Many come hoping to see wildlife, which is no longer as common in the American West as it once was.
Unfortunately, his style of visual humour had gone out of style and so his films were not as successful as before.

frames.frame: [主句] + as + [小句]（表伴随进程或原因）
frames.gloss: 随着……／由于……——as 从句后置，取「当…时/作为」之外的多义读法。
frames.pattern_notes:
as 从句跟在主句之后，本批三种读法并存：表同步进程（as we approached＝随着我们接近）、表同步变化（as new roads and railways were built＝随着），表原因（as there is no natural light＝因为）。
误读点：中文学习者默认把 as 读成「作为」或只认「当…时」，句尾 as 从句常被读慢或错挂成方式状语；需按主句语义（变化/状态+解释）选择「随着/因为」。
as 单词成骨架、无多词固定链，按判据 1 处于边界；因三例误读方向一致且频率高，报出供人工裁决。

examples.s: Endurance became stuck in the ice as we approached Antarctica.
Their habitats were becoming smaller as new roads and railways were built.
The tunnels are lit with pink LEDs as there is no natural light below the ground.

frames.gloss: ……在（做某事）的时候——when/while 后直接接 V-ing，省略的主语从上下文找回。
frames.pattern_notes:
when/while + V-ing 的时间状语从句省略「主语 + be」，逻辑主语承自主句主语或先行名词；位置可在句首（While diving in Greece, ...）也可插在名词与谓语之间（His lack of eye contact when talking with people shows...）。
误读点：句中位置时 V-ing 的挂靠对象隔得较远，逐词读会把 when/while + V-ing 挂错到邻近名词或当成伴随修饰。属已收「句首分词状语」的 when/while 显性标记 + 句中位置新变体；result_004 曾记 when + V-ed 被动省略单例（When asked whether...）。

examples.s: His lack of eye contact when talking with people shows that he lacks confidence.
A: Did you hear that James helped an old woman who fell down while crossing the street?
While diving in Greece, young Boyan Slat noticed there was more plastic waste than fish.

candidates.note: now that + [小句], [主句]：既然/如今……了（因果+时间混合）；骨架固定、误读强（now 易被读成纯时间副词），本批仅 1 例。

example.s: I used to think her job was pretty easy, but now that I am older, I realise that my mother deserves respect for doing an amazing job all these years.

candidates.note: There is little doubt that [A]：与 result_011 已记候选「There is no doubt that」同族，本批 little doubt 变体再 1 例；跨批已两例，批内单例，建议升级。

example.s: There is little doubt that Earth is getting warmer and warmer (see the graph).

candidates.note: [NP] are/is where [小句]（表语 where 从句）：result_005 曾记候选 S06082（Buckingham Palace is where...），本批为跨批第 2 例；批内仅 1 例。

example.s: The kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom are where most accidents happen.

candidates.note: [NP] be easy/difficult to [V]（tough 构式）：主语是不定式的逻辑宾语；result_005 候选 S06348 之后本批再 1 例，跨批两例，建议升级。

example.s: The Heimlich manoeuvre is quite easy/difficult to do.

candidates.note: [比较级] than you think：more A than anyone thought 家族又一变体（result_009 已记 a lot sooner than most people believe），本批单例。

example.s: You will get over tough times sooner than you think.

candidates.note: Without [NP], [主句]：没有……就（不能）……；已收「Given [NP], [主句]」的否定条件变体，主句配 could not，仅 1 例。

example.s: Without this process, Earth could not sustain life.

candidates.note: [量词] of whom/which：most of whom recovered＝其中多数人……；已收「介词+which/whom」的量词变体，仅 1 例。

example.s: • Later, the medicine was tested on malaria patients, most of whom recovered.

candidates.note: too [A] for [B]：已收 too...to 的 for 变体——「对 B 来说太……以致不适用」，仅 1 例。

example.s: There is no bridge and the river runs too quickly for boats.

candidates.note: not just [A] but also [B]：not only...but also 的口语变体，仅 1 例。

example.s: There are probably vast amounts of resources under the sea and ice, not just oil and gas but also valuable minerals.

candidates.note: for + [原因小句]：书面原因连词 for（＝因为）置于逗号后，易被读成「为了」，仅 1 例。

example.s: THE GIFT I want to give you something, my child, for we are drifting in the stream of the world.

candidates.note: in spite of + [NP]（后置于主句）：让步介词短语后置（..., in spite of its religious origins）；despite/in spite of 只接 NP 不接从句是经典误读点。本批另有一例 despite 填空题（S01861），语域不符不计。

example.s: Another example is Halloween, which slowly became an exciting festival for children, in spite of its religious origins.

candidates.note: Along with [A], there will also be [B]：不仅 A，还有 B；along with 易被读成「沿着」，仅 1 例。

example.s: But along with diﬃ culties, there will also be many exciting things waiting for you.

candidates.note: Much has been written about [A]：被动式话题开场（关于……已有大量著述），学术/评论语篇框架，仅 1 例。

example.s: STRONGER TOGETHER: HOW WE HAVE BEEN CHANGED BY THE INTERNET Much has been written about the wonders of the World Wide Web.

candidates.note: [A and B], both + [同位语]：并列两名词后用 both 引出追加同位（both in the western Pacific Ocean）；提顿式同位为 regex 盲区结构，仅 1 例。

example.s: The submersible made five dives in the Mariana Trench and the Yap Trench, both in the western Pacific Ocean.

candidates.note: Imagine [one's] surprise when [小句]：叙事者面向读者制造悬念的框架，仅 1 例。

example.s: Imagine her surprise when she saw the gold coins where the stone had been!

candidates.note: It is no surprise that [A]：评估性 that-框架（难怪……），与 There is no/little doubt that 同族，仅 1 例。

example.s: Thus, it is no surprise that more new graduates are now attracted to life in the country, where they can fulfil personal goals and contribute to their local communities rather than just being white-collar professionals in big cities.
